Delete my data

Opt-in — nothing is removed until you confirm. This cannot be undone.

Erased from this app

  • Your account, saved attendance, marks, timetable and personal details
  • Every login session, on every device
  • Your portal session stored here (the cookies this app saved)
  • Reminder subscriptions, the sent-reminder log and delivery receipts
  • Your usage/telemetry rows and your timetable edit-history entries
  • Your name on class-wide exam-tag confirmations — the shared confirmation stays

Never touched

  • The SRM portal itself — nothing is deleted on SRM's servers
  • Shared timetables and class-wide data other students rely on
  • Any other student's account

Afterwards you are signed out and returned to the login page.
